svg.text: East-facing plot · load-bearing 9" brick over ground floor walls · feet-inches · clear inside room sizes
Built-up, enclosed (outside of walls) = 362.2 sq ft
Open covered area under slab (Gallery) = 238.6 sq ft · Total covered = 600.9 sq ft
Cement sheet roof (Kitchen, Bathroom, Toilet) = 220.4 sq ft (single storey below)
Carpet (clear areas of enclosed rooms) = 306.4 sq ft
Walls = 55.9 sq ft · Ground coverage = 28.2% of plot
Open gaps (min): Left 2'-0" · Right 1'-0" · Front 29'-3" · Rear 26'-7½"
Teak/sal frame, 35mm panelled shutter, mortice lock
Aluminium/UPVC 3-track sliding, 3 shutters with mosquito mesh, MS safety grill
1. Do not scale the drawing; follow written dimensions. Room sizes are clear inside sizes (wall face to
2. First floor walls are 9" load-bearing brick, built directly over the ground floor walls below.
3. Gallery over Padavi: open, on the Padavi RCC slab, MS railing 3'-6" high on front and sides. The 6
RCC pillars continue up to carry the gallery roof slab (assumed, confirm with structural engineer).
4. Staircase comes up from Padavi and arrives on the gallery at the front-right. Leave an opening in
the gallery slab over the stair, with MS railing on its open edges.
5. Kitchen, Bathroom and Toilet stay single storey with fibre-cement corrugated roofing sheets on steel
purlins: lean-to sloping to the rear (West) at about 1:4, high end fixed to the first floor rear
wall below W2 with flashing, 6" overhang at the eaves.
6. Hall + Bedroom is one open space for now; partitions, toilet and terrace access to be decided later.
7. Assumed levels, confirm with engineer: floor-to-floor 10'-0", lintel +7'-0" above first floor.
8. Store room behind the kitchen is deferred; when it is built, extend the sheet roof over it (see
